terms_note: Ads API is partner-gated (request access via the Yelp account team); console ToS not read this session

discovery.auth: oauth2 (Yelp Partner APIs: OAuth authorization code / refresh tokens or Basic HTTP auth on partner-api.yelp.com)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (Yelp Partner Ads API + Reporting API v3) Confidence: **high** — official docs read.
auth: 1. Onboard to Yelp Partner APIs (partner agreement; 'Manage API Access').
2. OAuth authorization code → access + refresh tokens (or Basic HTTP auth on partner-api.yelp.com).
3. Create / update ad programs asynchronously (job ids), poll job status, pull Reporting v3.

Program features: CTAs, enhanced profile, business highlights, verified license
Leads API · Partner Support API · Listing Management · Data Ingestion

fields.name: username
fields.help: Yelp Partner API username (the same Basic-auth credentials as the Data Ingestion API; issued by your Yelp account team, access is disabled by default: https://docs.developer.yelp.com/docs/ads-api).

fields.name: password
fields.help: Yelp Partner API password (Basic HTTP authentication on partner-api.yelp.com).

adapter.terms: Yelp Ads API is a Partner API ('Access is disabled by default'; request access through your Yelp account team). Program writes are asynchronous jobs; budgets are monthly and in cents.

me.note: There is no account endpoint; the probe is GET /programs/v1?limit=1 (Program List All), which checks the Basic-auth partner credentials against the payment account.

list_campaigns.note: GET /programs/v1?offset&limit (max 40)&program_status: every advertising program (CPC, EP, BP, …) under the credentials' payment account; `account_id` is not sent (the credentials select the account). `status` is one of current/active, paused, past/ended, future/scheduled, all (Yelp's default is CURRENT). `name` is the program type; `budget` is the MONTHLY budget in cents (program_metrics.budget); raw.program_pause_status says NOT_PAUSED/PAUSED and raw.businesses lists the Yelp business ids.

pause_resume.note: POST /program/{program_id}/pause/v1 or /resume/v1 (HTTP 202, empty body) for a running CPC program. Yelp marks this 'This feature is coming soon — Please get in touch if you would like to get early access', so partners without early access get an error.

not_offered.list_accounts: The credentials are bound to one payment account; the Ads API has no account listing (https://docs.developer.yelp.com/docs/ads-api lists only create, edit, end, status, pause and resume).
not_offered.get_report: Reporting API v3 is asynchronous (POST https://api.yelp.com/v3/reporting/businesses/daily 'Requests a report … Use get_daily_reports_v3 to poll for report completion', https://docs.developer.yelp.com/reference/create_daily_reports_v3), keyed by business ids rather than programs, and authenticated with a Bearer API key on a different host from the Basic-auth partner API.
not_offered.update_budget: Yelp CPC budgets are monthly, not daily: POST /v1/reseller/program/{program_id}/edit?budget= takes 'Monthly budget in cents' and answers with an async job_id (https://docs.developer.yelp.com/docs/ads-api#modify-program); a daily budget cannot be set.
